title: An investigator's return to the coordinator (Assignment 6, Part B, task 2)
description: Structured, never prose. result, status, not_searched and could_not_determine come from the worker's return tool; searched and calls_used are added by the coordinator's code from the worker's own tool_call lines, never from the model. A return that breaks this schema is rejected, traced, and sent back to the worker.

issue.description: The issue this finding is for, as a number.

file.description: The one file most responsible, relative to the repository root, or none.

evidence.description: One or two sentences: what in that file explains the issue.

change.description: One or two sentences: what to change in that file; for a question, the answer.

searched.description: Every query the worker sent to the search tool and every path it read, each once, from its tool calls.

not_searched.description: What the worker knows it did not look at.

calls_used.description: The worker's calls to the registry's tools before it returned, from its tool_call lines.

could_not_determine.description: What the worker could not settle; empty when nothing.
